about:
Kansas Coil Spring Company has operated from Wichita, Kansas for over 30 years, producing certified aviation springs and wire forms. The business is managed by General Manager Justin Caywood, and its staff collectively holds more than 100 years of manufacturing experience.

The company specializes in spring manufacturing and wire forming, providing engineering and design assistance alongside production and delivery. Its quality management system is certified to AS9100D and ISO 9001:2015, ensuring traceability and compliance for aerospace and defense work.

Kansas Coil Spring serves the aerospace, agriculture, oil and gas, and U.S. government sectors, supplying springs and wire forms that meet stringent industry standards.

The firm emphasizes its depth of experience and full-service approach, from design support through final delivery, as key differentiators in the spring manufacturing market.
